teacherNotes.title: 5-Step Vocab Progression

teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: country, nationality, city, capital, from, world, flag, passport, UK, USA, France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Greece, Japan, China, Brazil

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
country, nationality, city, capital, from, world, flag, passport, UK, USA, France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Greece, Japan, China, Brazil
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where are you from? (asking origin)
• I am from... (stating country of origin)
• What nationality are you? (asking nationality)
• I am British / French / Italian (stating nationality)
• Where is he/she from? (asking third person origin)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Word stress in countries vs nationalities: 'China / 'Chinese, 'Italy / I'talian, 'Japan / Japa'nese.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Word stress in countries vs nationalities: 'China / 'Chinese, 'Italy / I'talian, 'Japan / Japa'nese.

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Verb 'be' + nationality adjective (I am Italian) vs Verb 'be' + 'from' + country noun (I am from Italy). Capitalization of countries and nationalities in English.

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Verb 'be' + nationality adjective (I am Italian) vs Verb 'be' + 'from' + country noun (I am from Italy). Capitalization of countries and nationalities in English.
Examples:

• Where are you from?
• I am from France.
• She is French.
• They are from Japan.
• We are Greek.
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: Where are you from?
Person B: I am from...
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can say where I am from and ask people about their nationality and origin.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Map Game; 10-25m Country & Nationality Vocab; 25-40m Grammar 'be' + nationality / from; 40-55m Passport Info-gap Task; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m Vocab & Stress Drills; 30-50m Grammar Substitution; 50-70m International Conference Roleplay; 70-85m Short Reading & Form Fill; 85-90m Wrap-up.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Globe Warm-up; 15-40m Phonetics & Word Stress Workshop; 40-70m Grammar System Practice; 70-100m World Summit Mingle; 100-115m Writing Profiles; 115-120m Summary.
